```{r import-data}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(e1071)
library(factoextra)

# 1. Create the data folder if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists("../data")) dir.create("../data")

# 2. Download the dataset directly to your computer first
data_url <- "https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/parkinsons/parkinsons.data"
dest_file <- "../data/parkinsons.csv"

if (!file.exists(dest_file)) {
  download.file(url = data_url, destfile = dest_file, mode = "wb")
}

# 3. Read the safely downloaded local file
parkinsons <- read_csv(dest_file)

# 4. Clean data: remove the patient 'name' column and factor the 'status' target (0 = Healthy, 1 = Parkinson's)
pk_clean <- parkinsons %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Healthy", "Parkinsons")))

# Verify cleaning
sum(is.na(pk_clean)) 
```
